JVNDB-2026-000122
Multiple vulnerabilities in CorvusSKK
Overview
CorvusSKK provided by SASAKI Nobuyuki contains multiple vulnerabilities listed below:
Code Injection (CWE-94) - CVE-2026-76148
Integer Overflow or Wraparound (CWE-190) - CVE-2026-76149
Ryo Shimada of Powder Keg Technologies, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
SASAKI Nobuyuki
CorvusSKK versions prior to 3.3.4
Impact
Arbitrary code may be executed on the affected product (CVE-2026-76148).
Malicious data may be written to a legitimate dictionary file (CVE-2026-76149).
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
